title: Robust Adaptation of Large Multimodal Models for Retrieval Augmented Hateful Meme Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework for improving the detection of hateful memes using Large Multimodal Models. While the subject matter (hateful content) inherently touches on social and ethical issues, and the datasets used include content targeting religious and other protected groups, the paper's core contribution is an architectural and fine-tuning adaptation method evaluated through classification metrics (AUC and Accuracy) rather than a benchmark or evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
